
{{alias}}( options )
    Returns an axis instance.

    Parameters
    ----------
    options: Object
        Options.

    options.aria: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG
        output. Default: true.

    options.bandPosition: number (optional)
        An interpolation fraction indicating where axis ticks should be
        positioned when an axis has a band scale.

    options.description: string (optional)
        Axis description. Default: ''.

    options.domain: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether the axis baseline should be included as part
        of the axis. Default: true.

    options.domainCap: string (optional)
        Stroke cap for axis domain line. Default: 'butt'.

    options.domainColor: string (optional)
        Color of axis domain line as a CSS color string (e.g., `'#f304d3'`,
        `'#ccc'`, `'rgb(253, 12, 134)'`, `'steelblue'`, etc).

    options.domainDash: Array<number> (optional)
        Stroke dash for axis domain line, where `[]` corresponds to a solid
        line. Default: [].

    options.domainDashOffset: number (optional)
        Pixel offset at which to start a domain line stroke dash.

    options.domainOpacity: number (optional)
        Opacity of axis domain line. Default: 1.

    options.domainWidth: number (optional)
        Stroke width of axis domain line.

    options.encode: Object (optional)
        Optional mark encodings for custom axis styling.

    options.format: string|Object (optional)
        Format specifier for axis tick labels.

    options.formatType: string (optional)
        Type of format to use for scales which do not have a strict domain data
        type.

    options.grid: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether grid lines should be included as part of the
        axis. Default: false.

    options.gridCap: string (optional)
        Stroke cap for axis grid lines. Default: 'butt'.

    options.gridColor: string (optional)
        Color of axis grid lines as a CSS color string (e.g., `'#f304d3'`,
        `'#ccc'`, `'rgb(253, 12, 134)'`, `'steelblue'`, etc).

    options.gridDash: Array<number> (optional)
        Stroke dash for axis grid lines, where `[]` corresponds to a solid line.
        Default: [].

    options.gridDashOffset: number (optional)
        Pixel offset at which to start a grid line stroke dash.

    options.gridOpacity: number (optional)
        Opacity of an axis grid line. Default: 1.

    options.gridScale: string (optional)
        Scale to use for including axis grid lines.

    options.gridWidth: number (optional)
        Stroke width of an axis grid line.

    options.labelAlign: string (optional)
        Horizontal text alignment of axis tick labels (overrides the default
        alignment based on the axis orientation).

    options.labelAngle: number (optional)
        Angle (in degrees) of axis tick labels.

    options.labelBaseline: string (optional)
        Vertical text baseline of axis tick labels (overrides the default
        baseline based on the axis orientation).

    options.labelBound: boolean|number (optional)
        Specifies how axis tick labels should be hidden when they exceed an axis
        range. Default: false.

    options.labelColor: string (optional)
        Color of axis tick label as a CSS color string (e.g., `'#f304d3'`,
        `'#ccc'`, `'rgb(253, 12, 134)'`, `'steelblue'`, etc).

    options.labelFlush: boolean|number (optional)
        Specifies flush alignment of axis tick labels at the beginning or ending
        of an axis scale range.

    options.labelFlushOffset: number (optional)
        Number of pixels by which to offset flush-adjusted axis tick labels.
        Default: 0.

    options.labelFont: string (optional)
        Font name for axis tick labels.

    options.labelFontSize: number (optional)
        Font size of axis tick labels.

    options.labelFontStyle: string (optional)
        Font style of axis tick labels (e.g., `'normal'`, `'italic'`, etc).

    options.labelFontWeight: string|number (optional)
        Font weight of axis tick labels.

    options.labelLimit: number (optional)
        Maximum allowed length in pixels of axis tick labels.

    options.labelLineHeight: number (optional)
        Line height (in pixels) for multi-line axis tick label text or axis tick
        label text with `'line-top'` or `'line-bottom'` baseline.

    options.labelOffset: number (optional)
        Position offset (in pixels) to apply to axis tick labels (in addition to
        `tickOffset`).

    options.labelOpacity: number (optional)
        Axis tick label opacity. Default: 1.

    options.labelOverlap: boolean|string (optional)
        Strategy to use for resolving overlapping axis tick labels. Default:
        false.

    options.labelPadding: number (optional)
        Padding (in pixels) between axis tick labels and tick marks.

    options.labels: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether axis tick labels should be included as part
        of the axis. Default: true.

    options.labelSeparation: number (optional)
        Minimum separation between axis tick label bounding boxes for them to be
        considered non-overlapping. Default: 0.

    options.maxExtent: number (optional)
        Maximum extent (in pixels) that axis tick marks and tick labels should
        use.

    options.minExtent: number (optional)
        Minimum extent (in pixels) that axis tick marks and tick labels should
        use.

    options.offset: number (optional)
        Orthogonal offset (in pixels) by which to displace an axis from its
        position along the edge of a chart.

    options.orient: string
        Axis orientation.

    options.position: number (optional)
        Anchor position (in pixels) of an axis. Default: 0.

    options.scale: string
        Axis scale.

    options.tickBand: string (optional)
        Type of axis tick style to use for an axis having a band scale.

    options.tickCap: string (optional)
        Stroke cap for axis tick marks. Default: 'butt'.

    options.tickColor: string (optional)
        Color of axis tick marks as a CSS color string (e.g., `'#f304d3'`,
        `'#ccc'`, `'rgb(253, 12, 134)'`, `'steelblue'`, etc).

    options.tickCount: number|string|Object (optional)
        Configuration for determining the number of axis tick marks.

    options.tickDash: Array<number> (optional)
        Stroke dash for axis tick marks, where `[]` corresponds to a solid line.
        Default: [].

    options.tickDashOffset: number (optional)
        Pixel offset at which to start an axis tick mark stroke dash.

    options.tickExtra: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether an extra axis tick should be added for the
        initial position of an axis.

    options.tickMinStep: number (optional)
        Minimum desired step between axis tick marks (in terms of scale domain
        values).

    options.tickOffset: number (optional)
        Position offset (in pixels) to apply to axis tick marks, labels, and
        grid lines.

    options.tickOpacity: number (optional)
        Opacity of axis tick marks. Default: 1.

    options.tickRound: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating if pixel position values of axis ticks should be
        rounded to the nearest integer.

    options.ticks: boolean (optional)
        Boolean indicating whether axis tick marks should be included as part of
        an axis. Default: true.

    options.tickSize: number (optional)
        Length (in pixels) of axis tick marks.

    options.tickWidth: number (optional)
        Width (in pixels) of axis tick marks.

    options.title: string|Array<string> (optional)
        Axis title. Default: [ '' ].

    options.titleAlign: string (optional)
        Axis title horizontal text alignment.

    options.titleAnchor: string|null (optional)
        Axis title anchor position. Default: null.

    options.titleAngle: number (optional)
        Axis title angle (in degrees).

    options.titleBaseline: string (optional)
        Vertical baseline of axis title (overrides the default baseline based on
        the axis orientation).

    options.titleColor: string (optional)
        Color of axis title as a CSS color string (e.g., `'#f304d3'`, `'#ccc'`,
        `'rgb(253, 12, 134)'`, `'steelblue'`, etc).

    options.titleFont: string (optional)
        Axis title font name.

    options.titleFontSize: number (optional)
        Axis title font size.

    options.titleFontStyle: string (optional)
        Axis title font style (e.g., `'normal'`, `'italic'`, etc).

    options.titleFontWeight: string|number (optional)
        Axis title font weight.

    options.titleLimit: number (optional)
        Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of axis title.

    options.titleLineHeight: number (optional)
        Line height (in pixels) for multi-line title text or for title text with
        `'line-top'` or `'line-bottom'` baseline.

    options.titleOpacity: number (optional)
        Axis title opacity. Default: 1.

    options.titlePadding: number (optional)
        Padding (in pixels) between axis tick labels and the axis title.

    options.titleX: number (optional)
        Custom `x` position of the axis title relative to the axis group
        (overrides the standard layout).

    options.titleY: number (optional)
        Custom `y` position of the axis title relative to the axis group
        (overrides the standard layout).

    options.translate: number (optional)
        Axis layout coordinate space translation offset. Default: 0.5.

    options.values: Collection (optional)
        Explicit set of axis tick mark and label values.

    options.zindex: integer (optional)
        Integer z-index indicating the layering of the axis group relative to
        other axis, mark, and legend groups. Default: 0.

    Returns
    -------
    axis: Axis
        Axis instance.

    axis.aria
        Boolean indicating whether ARIA attributes should be included in SVG
        output.

    axis.bandPosition
        Interpolation fraction indicating where axis ticks should be positioned
        when an axis has a band scale.

    axis.description
        Axis description.

    axis.domain
        Boolean indicating whether the axis baseline should be included as part
        of an axis.

    axis.domainCap
        Stroke cap for an axis domain line.

    axis.domainColor
        Color of an axis domain line as a CSS color string.

    axis.domainDash
        Stroke dash for an axis domain line.

    axis.domainDashOffset
        Pixel offset at which to start an axis domain line dash array.

    axis.domainOpacity
        Opacity of an axis domain line.

    axis.domainWidth
        Stroke width of an axis domain line.

    axis.encode
        Optional mark encodings for custom axis styling.

    axis.format
        Format specifier for axis tick labels.

    axis.formatType
        Type of format to use for axis scales which do not have a strict domain
        data type.

    axis.grid
        Boolean indicating whether grid lines should be included as part of an
        axis.

    axis.gridCap
        Stroke cap for axis grid lines.

    axis.gridColor
        Color of axis grid lines as a CSS color string.

    axis.gridDash
        Stroke dash for axis grid lines.

    axis.gridDashOffset
        Pixel offset at which to start an axis grid line stroke dash.

    axis.gridOpacity
        Opacity of axis grid lines.

    axis.gridScale
        Scale name to use for including axis grid lines.

    axis.gridWidth
        Stroke width of axis grid lines.

    axis.labelAlign
        Horizontal text alignment of axis tick labels.

    axis.labelAngle
        Angle (in degrees) of axis tick labels.

    axis.labelBaseline
        Vertical baseline of axis tick labels.

    axis.labelBound
        Setting indicating whether axis tick labels should be hidden if they
        exceed the axis range.

    axis.labelColor
        Color of axis tick labels.

    axis.labelFlush
        Setting indicating whether axis tick labels at the beginning or end of
        the axis should be aligned flush with the scale range.

    axis.labelFlushOffset
        Number of pixels by which to offset flush-adjusted labels.

    axis.labelFont
        Font name for axis tick labels.

    axis.labelFontSize
        Font size (in pixels) of axis tick labels.

    axis.labelFontStyle
        Font style of axis tick labels.

    axis.labelFontWeight
        Font weight of axis tick labels.

    axis.labelLimit
        Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of axis tick labels.

    axis.labelLineHeight
        Line height (in pixels) for multi-line axis tick label text or axis tick
        label text with "line-top" or "line-bottom" baseline.

    axis.labelOffset
        Position offset (in pixels) to apply to labels in addition to
        `tickOffset`.

    axis.labelOpacity
        Opacity of axis tick labels.

    axis.labelOverlap
        Strategy to use for resolving overlapping axis tick labels.

    axis.labelPadding
        Padding (in pixels) between axis ticks and tick labels.

    axis.labelSeparation
        Minimum separation (in pixels) between axis tick label bounding boxes
        for them to be considered non-overlapping.

    axis.labels
        Boolean indicating whether axis tick labels should be included as part
        of the axis.

    axis.maxExtent
        Maximum extent (in pixels) that axis ticks and labels should use.

    axis.minExtent
        Minimum extent (in pixels) that axis ticks and labels should use.

    axis.offset
        Orthogonal offset (in pixels) by which to displace the axis from its
        position along the edge of a chart.

    axis.orient
        Axis orientation.

    axis.position
        Anchor position of an axis (in pixels).

    axis.properties
        List of enumerable properties.

    axis.scale
        Name of the scale which maps data values to visual values along an axis.

    axis.tickBand
        Axis tick style to use in conjunction with band scales.

    axis.tickCap
        Stroke cap for axis tick marks.

    axis.tickColor
        Color of axis tick marks.

    axis.tickCount
        Desired number of axis tick marks for an axis visualizing a quantitative
        scale.

    axis.tickDash
        Stroke dash of axis tick marks.

    axis.tickDashOffset
        Pixel offset at which to start an axis tick mark dash array.

    axis.tickExtra
        Boolean indicating whether an extra axis tick mark should be added for
        the initial position of an axis.

    axis.tickMinStep
        Minimum desired step between axis tick marks in terms of axis scale
        domain values.

    axis.tickOffset
        Position offset (in pixels) to apply to axis tick marks, labels, and
        gridlines.

    axis.tickOpacity
        Opacity of axis tick marks.

    axis.tickRound
        Boolean indicating whether pixel position values should be rounded to
        the nearest integer.

    axis.tickSize
        Length (in pixels) of axis tick marks.

    axis.tickWidth
        Width (in pixels) of axis tick marks.

    axis.ticks
        Boolean indicating whether axis tick marks should be included as part of
        the axis.

    axis.title
        Axis title.

    axis.titleAlign
        Horizontal text alignment of an axis title.

    axis.titleAnchor
        Anchor position for placing an axis title.

    axis.titleAngle
        Angle (in degrees) of an axis title.

    axis.titleBaseline
        Vertical baseline of an axis title.

    axis.titleColor
        Color of an axis title.

    axis.titleFont
        Font name for an axis title.

    axis.titleFontSize
        Font size (in pixels) of an axis title.

    axis.titleFontStyle
        Font style of an axis title.

    axis.titleFontWeight
        Font weight of an axis title.

    axis.titleLimit
        Maximum allowed length (in pixels) of an axis title.

    axis.titleLineHeight
        Line height (in pixels) for multi-line axis title text or axis title
        text with "line-top" or "line-bottom" baseline.

    axis.titleOpacity
        Opacity of an axis title.

    axis.titlePadding
        Padding (in pixels) between axis tick labels and an axis title.

    axis.titleX
        Custom `x` position of the axis title relative to the axis group.

    axis.titleY
        Custom `y` position of the axis title relative to the axis group.

    axis.translate
        Coordinate space translation offset for axis layout.

    axis.values
        Explicit set of axis tick mark and label values.

    axis.zindex
        Integer z-index indicating the layering of the title group relative to
        other axis, mark, and legend groups.

    axis.toJSON()
        Serializes an axis instance to a JSON object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var opts = { 'scale': 'xScale', 'orient': 'bottom' };
    > var axis = new {{alias}}( opts )
    <Axis>
    > axis.orient
    'bottom'

    // Set a property:
    > axis.title = 'x';
    > axis.title
    [ 'x' ]

    // Serialize to JSON:
    > axis.toJSON()
    {...}

    See Also
    --------
